title: Loop Contract: turn a recurring task into a proper loop
summary: Before a recurring job ever runs, Claude writes a contract for it: the goal, the scope, a checker that proves it worked, a budget, and when to stop and ask you. Pairs with Pipeline QC.
how_to_use: Say "make this a loop" or "turn this into a daily job".
requires: Claude Code. Works best alongside the pipeline-qc skill.
